name: Dot Circle Expand
description: A center dot surrounded by four corner dots that expand outward and contract back in a pulsing pattern

variations.name: default
variations.description: Static center dot with four corner dots that pulse outward and return, creating a dynamic radial expansion effect

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: centerDotSize
props.description: Diameter of the center dot in pixels

props.name: cornerDotSize
props.description: Diameter of each corner dot in pixels

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
